summary: Carousel of hero slides (title, subtitle, decorative image, optional call-to-action link) with previous/next buttons, picker dots and an optional autoplay with pause control.

inputs.name: slides
inputs.description: Slides {id, title, subtitle?, imageSrc?, link?, linkLabel?}, already translated.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: The shown slide; two-way bindable with [(index)].

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the slider region.

inputs.name: pauseLabel
inputs.description: Label of the rotation button while slides rotate.

inputs.name: playLabel
inputs.description: Label of the rotation button while paused.

inputs.name: autoplay
inputs.description: Advance on a timer; never under prefers-reduced-motion.

inputs.name: intervalMs
inputs.description: Autoplay interval in milliseconds; raised to at least 3000.

outputs.name: indexChange
outputs.description: The shown slide changed (model output of index).

a11y: WAI-ARIA carousel: a named region, each slide a labelled group, aria-live off while rotating and polite otherwise. Rotation holds while pointer or focus is inside, stops when paused, and never runs under prefers-reduced-motion. Dots carry aria-current; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight on the dots move along the visual order (mirrored in RTL).
